newsitem.title: MOROCCO: General Electric in deal with Moroccan firm.
newsitem.headline: General Electric in deal with Moroccan firm.

text.p: General Electric Co unit GE Information Services and Morocco's Finas firm announced on Wednesday the setting up of a joint venture in Casablanca to promote trade in electronic services, a statement issued by the group said.

"The new company will focus on providing the local market with state-of-the-art eletronic commerce services to enable local companies to improve their productivity and competitiveness," the statement said.
The initial capital of the joint-venture was estimated at $3.0 million, the group said.
A spokesman of General Electric said "Morocco is an important market for our products and we are committed to continuing our investment in this region."
The new company will play a key role in helping Moroccan businesses penetrate the European market after Morocco's agreement with the European economic community, a Moroccan banker said.
Last year, Morocco and the European Union signed an association accord which will help the North African country to integrate Europe's free trade zone by the year 2010.
